item.name: ILSmart
item.summary: Search aircraft parts, receive and quote RFQs, send RFQs and keep inventory listings on ILSmart up to date.
item.description:
Connect workflows to ILSmart, the aviation and marine parts marketplace of Inventory Locator Service, through its SOAP web services. Everyday steps check the availability of a list of part numbers, receive new RFQs, quote every item of an RFQ, send a parts RFQ and upload an inventory file, then follow its processing.

Each of the 61 services of the ILS SOAP 1.1 WSDL (all but the mobile variants and the legacy text search) has its own step: searches and market statistics, part and MRO listings, RFQs and quotes, documents and messages. Amounts are exact decimals. A connection is an ILS user ID and its password.
item.setup_summary: Add your ILS user ID and password to a project connection and run the connection test; the services you can call depend on your ILS subscription.
